name: Aizawl, Mizoram (provisional pilot)
boundary_note: Pilot bounding box — not an official administrative boundary

sources.provider: ESA / Copernicus (via AWS Open Data, Sinergise)
sources.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (DGED, 2021 release), Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF
sources.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (ESA User Licence + CCM Mission Specific Annex); GLO-30 'available worldwide with a free license' per https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions/collections-description/COP-DEM
sources.attribution_text: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
sources.status_note: Surface model (DSM): includes buildings and tree canopy. Slope/relief derived by GeoRakshak pipeline.

metadata.processing: COG window -> bilinear reproject to EPSG:32646 at 25 m -> Horn slope; per-cell mean/max slope, mean elevation, relief = max-min elevation
metadata.resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m), resampled to 25 m in EPSG:32646

sources.provider: ESA WorldCover consortium (via AWS Open Data)
sources.dataset: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 derived land cover)
sources.licence: CC-BY 4.0 (AWS Open Data registry entry esa-worldcover-vito)
sources.attribution_text: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
sources.status_note: Per-cell majority class (landcover_class) and tree-cover share. Map year 2021; may not reflect later change.

sources.dataset: Global Landslide Catalog records via COOLR Reports Points feature service (GLC + Landslide Reporter)
sources.licence: NASA 'Permission to Use, Reproduce, and Distribute' text attached to the NASA Landslide Viewer web map item (gis.earthdata.nasa.gov item 316937f6b8934de7ba69b45c4688598c); data.nasa.gov legacy export lists 'License not specified'. Citation requested: Kirschbaum et al. 2010 (doi:10.1007/s11069-009-9401-4); Kirschbaum et al. 2015 (doi:10.1016/j.geomorph.2015.03.016).
sources.attribution_text: Landslide records: NASA Global Landslide Catalog / COOLR, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (landslides.nasa.gov)
sources.status_note: Media-derived catalogue: incomplete and biased toward roads/settlements; many locations accurate only to 1-50 km. Records in pilot bbox span 2009-2021. Kept as a secondary inventory next to gsi-bhusanket (surveyed) and zenodo-aizawl-rsf-2026 (dated); it was the v2 Stage A label source, v3 uses gsi-bhusanket.

metadata.past_landslide_density_method: count of gsi-bhusanket (GSI surveyed) records within 2000 m of the cell centroid / 12.57 km2 (all records; not fold-safe)

sources.dataset: OSM highway ways (motorway, motorway_link, trunk, trunk_link, primary, primary_link, secondary, secondary_link, tertiary, tertiary_link, unclassified, residential, track)
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
sources.status_note: Snapshot; split at intersections and at <= 1000 m. Completeness not assessed.

sources.dataset: OSM places (city/town/village/hamlet), schools/colleges, health facilities, bridges (highway bridge=yes midpoints), shelters (emergency=assembly_point, social_facility=shelter)
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
sources.status_note: OSM facility coverage in the pilot is visibly incomplete (e.g. few schools mapped). No population attached.

sources.dataset: IMD high-resolution 0.25x0.25 degree daily gridded rainfall (binary .grd), year 2017
sources.licence: No open licence found. IMD Pune website disclaimer (https://imdpune.gov.in/disclaimer.html): data 'should not be reproduced anywhere without prior permission'. Citation requested: Pai et al. 2014, MAUSAM 65(1):1-18. Team decision/permission needed before redistribution or public display.
sources.attribution_text: Rainfall: India Meteorological Department, 0.25° gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al., 2014)
sources.status_note: Replay window 2017-05-15..2017-06-30. Nearest 0.25° grid point per cell (~25 km grid vs 500 m cells): only 4 distinct series across the pilot.

metadata.format: little-endian float32, days x 129 x 135, lat 6.5-38.5N, lon 66.5-100E, undef -999

sources.dataset: GSI public landslide inventory (ArcGIS FeatureServer layer Landslide_Public), NER states
sources.licence: GSI Bhusanket Terms of Use (https://bhusanket.gsi.gov.in/terms.html), quoted: 'Material featured on this Portal may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission by sending a mail to us ... the source must be prominently acknowledged.' No open licence. PERMISSION IS REQUIRED before any redistribution or public display of this data or maps derived from it.
sources.attribution_text: Landslide inventory: Geological Survey of India (Bhusanket portal); individual records carry their own GSI report citation
sources.status_note: Surveyed inventory / macro-scale (1:50,000) susceptibility mapping records: 8,691 in the 8 NER states, 132 in the pilot bbox. Fields date, date_acc and geo_acc are empty for NER, so most records are undated (2,270 carry an initiation year) and no position accuracy is asserted. Supports Stage A susceptibility only, not dated Stage B. Team action: request GSI permission before publishing anything derived from it.

metadata.note: bhukosh.gsi.gov.in (the portal named in data-strategy S15) is still unreachable; this is a different, reachable GSI host.

sources.dataset: Aizawl landslide inventory 2015-2025 (19 dated events) accompanying the Mizoram rate-and-state friction study
sources.attribution_text: Sarma, P. & Paul, K. (2026), Aizawl landslide inventory 2015-2025, Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20783995, CC-BY-4.0
sources.status_note: 18 of 19 events fall inside the pilot bbox, all dated (2016-2025) with fatality counts. Coordinates are 'Reported' (DMS from the cited source) for 3 records and 'Approximate' (locality-derived) for the rest; the dataset states no metric accuracy.

Unreachable on 2026-09-17 (11 attempts) and 2026-09-18 (7 more, including guessed ArcGIS/GeoServer paths): DNS resolves to 144.24.99.164 but every TCP connect to 443 and 80 times out. Superseded for our purposes by the reachable GSI host bhusanket.gsi.gov.in (slug gsi-bhusanket). Log: ml/data/raw/inventory_hunt/attempts.tsv.
Not processed yet; ndvi_mean absent from static_features.
